node.statement: Projection-basis input: node 1.6 makes B a finite-dimensional commutative unital C*-algebra. The permitted byte-verbatim external projection-basis-kitaev-1361 states that such an algebra is described by a projection basis {Pi_1,...,Pi_k} with Pi_j*=Pi_j, Pi_j Pi_l=delta_{jl}Pi_l, and sum_j Pi_j=1. Because it is a basis, k>=1, every Pi_j is nonzero, and the Pi_j linearly span B.
